summary: Russia experienced one of its largest drone attacks with 791 Ukrainian drones neutralized across multiple regions including Moscow, where over 150 were downed causing injuries and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian air defenses reported shooting down 111 of 147 attack drones launched overnight. Simultaneously, Russian forces claimed liberation of Novosoloshino in Zaporizhzhia region while Ukrainian pilots struck enemy personnel near Novomykolaivka.

sections.executive_summary: Russia faced a massive overnight drone attack with 791 Ukrainian drones neutralized across its territory, including over 150 shot down in Moscow region causing civilian injuries and infrastructure fires. Ukrainian air defenses simultaneously engaged 147 Russian attack drones, downing 111. On the ground, Russian forces claimed capture of Novosoloshino in Zaporizhzhia region while Ukrainian aviation struck enemy positions near Novomykolaivka.

points: Ukrainian air defense forces shot down 111 of 147 Russian attack drones (Shahed, Gerbera, Parodiya types) launched overnight August 17-18 from Kursk, Orel, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk and Crimea, with hits recorded at 19 locations and debris at 3 locations. (Source: @kpszsu/73277)
Ukrainian 67th OMBr 'Zalizni Sokoly' pilots conducted airstrike on Russian personnel near Novomykolaivka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23748)

Ukrainian drone attack on Russian territory reached unprecedented scale with 791 drones neutralized over Russian regions, Azov and Black Seas, including strikes on Moscow region infrastructure and Greek tanker Skiros in Black Sea. (Source: @tass_agency/390795)

Multiple waves of Ukrainian jet drones (Shahed) tracked moving from Chernihiv region through Slavutych toward Kyiv region targets including Velyka Dymerka and Brovary, with 6+ drones in first wave and 5+ in subsequent wave. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70305, @eRadarrua/105818, @kpszsu/73265)
Ukrainian forces launched jet drones toward Odesa and Mykolaiv regions from Black Sea, and KAB guided bombs struck southern Dnipropetrovsk and Donbas regions. (Source: @kpszsu/73225, @kpszsu/73226)

Russian air defenses neutralized 791 Ukrainian drones overnight, including over 150 in Moscow region, 65 in Voronezh, 25 in Kaluga, and 80+ in Rostov region, with damage to residential areas, Wildberries warehouses, and fires in Pavlovsky Posad and Kolomna. (Source: @tass_agency/390795)

sections.threat_assessment: The unprecedented scale of mutual drone warfare marks a significant escalation, with Ukraine demonstrating deep-strike capacity against Moscow's energy and logistics infrastructure while Russia saturates Ukrainian airspace with multi-axis drone waves targeting Kyiv. Russian A-50U deployment has effectively neutralized Ukraine's Flamingo cruise missile program, forcing reliance on mass drone attacks. Ground operations show Russian incremental gains in Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv sectors, while Ukrainian aviation maintains localized strike capability. The Moldova incident risks expanding the conflict's geographic footprint.
sections.regional_response: EU foreign policy chief Kallas announced an autumn sanctions package projected to increase designated Russian entities by approximately one-third, signaling sustained economic pressure. Latvia's €7 billion EU budget request quantifies the regional cost of sanctions enforcement and defense posture changes. Thailand expressed interest in accelerating FTA negotiations with the Eurasian Economic Union, indicating some non-Western states seek deeper economic ties with Russia despite the war.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian FPV drone tactics in Belgorod region show systematic targeting of civilian and military logistics vehicles, suggesting a campaign to disrupt border region supply lines. Ukrainian drone corridors through Chernihiv-Slavutych-Kyiv remain consistent, indicating established penetration routes. The 'Banderoil' hybrid missile-drone entering Moldova suggests either navigation failure or deliberate trajectory through neutral airspace. Russian detention of alleged Ukrainian agent in Ryazan collecting defense and energy infrastructure data confirms active HUMINT operations inside Russia.
